name: Human Performance and AI in Sports Analytics Minor
intro: This interdisciplinary program prepares students to apply AI, data science, as well as human and sport performance principles to improve athletic outcomes and reduce risk of injuries. With this minor, students are able to generate data-driven insights for key stakeholders throughout the sports industry ecosystem, thereby advancing human and athletic performance.
